0.description: Felforged now get Felforged Souls on levelup and on death based on the level they reached.
Mythic+ will now grant +2 or +3 to your Keystone if you complete it within the 40% or 60% time brackets.
[Area 52] Felforged are now able to login, but will be unable to leave the twistingnether. This will let you access vanity items you had on these characters.
Pet's will now always synchronise their level with their owner.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed a recent issue where Travel Form would let you break out of Polymorphs. (You're only immune against Polymorph while in Travel Form but you can't break out of them after getting Polymorphed.)
Fixed a bug where Pets would stop auto attacking if feared.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where the fix from October 16th preventing Bulwark from triggering weapon on-hit effects wasn't properly applied to live realms.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Presence of Mind had stopped working with Frost Bomb.
[Area 52] Dragon Roar now deals 30% less damage vs players, changed from 20%.
Slam now deals 20% less damage vs players while Dragon Warrior is active.
Dragon Charge now gives 5 sec of Draconic Might, changed from 10.

1.description: [Pending Patch] Clarified the wording of the tooltip on Improved Spirit Tap.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Taunt and Growl unintendedly could trigger certain proc effects.

0.description: [Felforged] Added Mystic Draught to Beezlebub for gold. This item grants you 1 Mystic Enchanting level instantly.
Silas and Burth now offer Darkmoon Ticket pouches that allow you to transfer tickets between characters under the toys and cosmetics tab.
Enchant Collection will now sort by highest quality first instead of lowest.
Vanity Collection items will now sort alphabetically within their categories.

6.description: [Area 52] Pending Restart - Reduced the health of Doom Lord Kazzak and Doomwalker by 33%.
[Area 52] [Mythic Dungeons] Pending Restart - Mythic+ Preparations - Reduced the health of all creatures in all Mythic Dungeons by 33%.

1.description: [Pending Restart] The nature damage from the Improved Feral Spirit capstone has been increased by 100% vs monsters.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Arcane Synergy now gives 2% cast time decrease to Starfire, changed from 1%. Now stacks up to 15, changed from 25.

[Pending Restart] Blade Vortex cooldown reduction to Blade Flurry now correctly only triggers on one-handed melee auto-attacks. It will now work while Titan's Grip is active (if you're attacking with one-handed weapons).

0.description: Disabled rotating Honorable Combat Zones in Vanilla until some bugs are fixed. Winterspring and WPL will be the HC zones.

7.description: Clarified the tooltip of Dragon Warrior to specify that the procced Dragon Fury attack from using the empowered Slam is what is giving stacks and cooldown reduction on Dragon Roar, not the Slam. As such, this effect is not doubled when using Single-Minded Fury.
[Pending Restart] Double Down weapon damage is now lowered but scales with levels up to 60. (To lower its power during early levels. Its damage is unchanged for level 60 and above.)
[Pending Restart] Instant Wrath's casted with the Predator's Wrath mystic enchant now deals 10% less damage vs players.

[Pending Restart] Frost Reserve will now properly increase damage of the damaging spell instead of adding another damage spell on top of it. It will now only consume one stack for spells that hit multiple targets.

1.description: Changed the tooltip of Survival Instinct to clarify that the ability is only usable while in Bear Form, Cat Form, or Dire Bear Form.
Fixed an issue where Ice Block would not always activate.
Rebirth is no longer usable while in High-Risk.
[Pending Restart] Increased the healing power scaling of Earth Shield by 10%.
[Pending Restart] Berserk now also reduces the rage cost of Bear Form abilities by 50%.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where the Frost Bomb pulse and explosion would not trigger if the target is not in line of sight.

0.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed a bug where Felforged could not mail Skillcards. Skillcards are meant to be obtained on your regular characters by doing felforged.
Increased Soul gain from PvP Felforged kills from last league.
Fixed Chestpocalyse issue where chests would build up on the shore of Zoram Strand from Highrisk
Raised Felforged experience bonus from 600 to 750.

[Tier 5 2 Set Bonus] For the Protection warrior now correctly grants 10% total Strength. 

Previously it would not increase Strength by your total amount.

6.description: [Mythic+] Pending Restart - Removed 4 Champions in the "Lava Run" area of Blackrock Depths, 2 Champions from Stratholme - Service Entrance and 3 Champions from Upper Blackrock Spire.
[Mythic+] Increased the completion time of Stratholme - Service Entrance by 6 minutes.
[Mythic+] Increased the damage reduction of Pack Tactics for every nearby ally to 8% up from 7%.
[Mythic+] Reduced the maximum health damage conversion of Corpse Explosion to 8% maximum health down from 10%.
[Mythic+] Reduced the Amplitude of Frostborn Champions Glacial aura by 100% and stack limit to 6 down from 10.
[Mythic+] Stratholme - Baron Rivendare once again is the final boss of Stratholme and now required to complete the dungeon.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Blade Vortex cooldown could be reduced while using a two-handed off-hand weapon with Titan's Grip.
[Pending Restart] Frost Bomb now works with Molten Fury talent and mystic enchant.
[Pending Restart] Chaos Meteor now works with Ignite.

0.description: Fixed an issue where some mythic+ shields had the incorrect block value on shield.

6.description: [Mythic+] Pending Restart - Reduced the required creature count to complete Scholomance to 319 from 351 in response of Scholomance Students no longer counting towards the creature count.

0.description: Restored the original values & weapon speed of Deathbringer. (Weapon from Onyxia). We are working on diversifying melee weapon diversification in raids by opening up NEW & more weapon choices from raids.
Fixed the range on Fire Fire Fireball. If you are 41 yard range from the target, fire fire fireball will still fire.
Fixed an issue where immunities could prevent Fire Fire Fireball from triggering.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where you still required stances to be able to roll Thunder Clap.

1.description: [Pending Restart] [Alar] Mortal Strike now deals 45% reduced damage vs players, changed from 40%.
[Pending Restart] Auto-attacks now deal 10% less damage vs players, changed from 5%.
[Pending Restart] Mutilate now deals 15% reduced damage vs players, changed from 10%.
[Pending Restart] Mutilate now deals 145% weapon damage, changed from 135%.
[Pending Restart] Conflagrate now deals damage equal to 70% of your Immolate for its damage over time effect, changed from 60%.

Fixed an issue where Sanctity of Battle's damage reduction on Holy Fire would override and make other damage % increases to Holy Fire null & void. This means Righteous Flames & Sanctity of Battle will now work simultaneously.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where ranks 3 and 4 of Dragon's Breath had 35 seconds cooldown instead of 30. The cooldown display will be updated to reflect this soon.
[Pending Restart] Elemental Fury now affects Lightning Shield.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Sinister Flurry now deals 10% reduced damage vs players. It previously did not have a PvP modifer.
[Pending Restart] [Alar] Sinister Strike (Double Down) now deals 30% less damage vs players, changed from 20%.
[Pending Restart] The Draconic Might buff from Dragon Warrior now increases physical damage done vs players by 10%, changed from 15%. (Damage increase vs monsters unchanged.)
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Concussion Blow (Stormhammer) could be dodged and parried.
[Pending Restart] The damage from Frost Bomb will now trigger Frostbite.
[Pending Restart] Frost Bomb will now be affected by the Arctic Reach talent and mystic enchant. [Requires Launcher update]
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where critical damage from Molten Earth didn't benefit from the Elemental Fury talent.
Deconstruct now deals 25% less damage versus players, changed from 15%.

5.description: [Pending Restart] The damage proc of the 4-piece setbonus of Gladiator's Raiment (the Satin set) no longer triggers against targets afflicted by Dragon's Breath. This means that if you use the set, your Dragon's Breath won't seemingly randomly break any more.
Pending Restart - Removed the unique item limit category from all Headless Horseman Blades. Player can now equip two Blades of any combination.

6.description: [Blackrock Depths] Reduced the health and damage of Princess Moira Bronzebeared by 50% and reduced her level to 62 from 63.
[Blackrock Spire] Reduced the health of Gyth and Rend Blackhand by 50%.

3.description: Improved website routing. The website will now remember and return you to the previous page you visited before prior to being prompted to login/register, for the purpose of improving UX through reduced friction.

6.description: Reduced the potency of Mana Drain used by creatures inside Scholomance by 30% per tick on Heroic and Mythic difficulty.

[Mythic+] Pending Restarts - Reduced the radius of Infernal Pact - Molten persistent ground effect and Infernal Pact - Mortar impact damage to 2 yards down from 3 to better match the effects visual radius.

[Mythic+] Pending Restarts - All Mythic dungeons Mythic 14 and higher now require 5 Champions to be slain in order to complete. Previously would require a number of Champions equal to the required number of Bosses.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Arcane Motes now increases the damage of Moonfire by 3%, changed from 2%. (Correction of the previous changelog entry.)
[Alar] Locust Shot now deals 25% less damage versus players, changed from 20%.
[Alar] Chimera Shot - Serpent now deals 30% less damage versus players, changed from 25%.

[Pending Restart] Overflow no longer heals the lowest percent health ally but instead a random ally. The heal amount based on Healing Touch has been increased to 30%, changed from 20%. It will now correctly heal a nearby ally based on the position of the target healed rather then the caster. (The smart heal was reverted as it was causing these issues. We are still looking into a solution to make it work as it should with the smart heal, but we wanted to push something to make it feel better to use now.)
[Pending Restart] Stormborn now deals 33% increased damage!
[Pending Restart] Chaos Meteor now also triggers Wild Felfire, Chaos Manifesting and Controlled Burn.

6.description: [Serpentshrine Cavern] [Leotheras the Blind] Pending Restarts - Chaos Blast now increases Fire damage taken by 200% up from 100% per stack.
[Serpentshrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj] Pending Restarts - Increased the damage of Multi-Shot to 50% weapon damage up from 40%.
[Serpentshrine Cavern] [The Lurker Below] Pending Restarts - Increased the damage of The Lurker Belows Whirl ability to 50% weapon damage up from 40%.
[Serpentshrine Cavern] [Leotheras the Blind] Increased the damage of Leotheras the Blinds Whirlwind ability to 50% weapon damage up from 40%.
[Serpentshrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj] Pending Restarts - Reduced the damage of Phoenix Ember Blast by 25%.
[Serpentshrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj] Pending Restarts - Increased the damage of Phoenix Rebirth by 50%.
[Serpentshrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj] Pending Restarts - Increased the damage of Phoenix Burn by 30%.
[Serpentshrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj] Pending Restarts - Reduced the damage of Toxic Spores by 40%.
[Serpentshrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj] Pending Restarts - Increased the damage of Tainted Elemental Poison Bolt by 40%.
[Serpentshrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj] Pending Restarts - Reduced the damage of Forked Lightning by 25%.
[Serpentshrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj] Pending Restarts - Reduced the damage of Static Blast by 25%. Static Blast now deals 50% increased damage for every target it jumps to up from 30%.
[Serpentshrine Cavern] [Leotheras the Blind] Pending Restarts - Creeping Felfire now deals 20% less damage.

[Serpentshrine Cavern] [Leotheras the Blind] Pending Restarts - Chaosblast now deals 25% less damage on Normal and Heroic difficulty, 50% less damage on Ascended 10 player difficulty and 80% less damage on Ascended 25 player difficulty.
[Serpentshrine Cavern] [Leotheras the Blind] Pending Restarts - Chaosblast no longer shares damage between targets hit.

[Serpentshrine Cavern] [Fathomlord Karathress] Pending Restarts - Reduced the damage per jump of Fathom Guard caribdis Chain Lightning by 10% on Normal Heroic and Ascended 10 player mode and by 5% on Ascended 25 player mode.
[Serpentshrine Cavern] [Fathomlord Karathress] Pending Restarts - Reduced the damage of Fathom Guard Caribdiss Hurricane by ~ 40%.
